lines.text: Many learners say: Because it rained, so we stayed home.
Better: Because it rained, we stayed home.
I rested! Because I was tired, I rested.

data.wrong: Because it rained, so we stayed home.
data.right: Because it rained, we stayed home.

native.tip: हिंदी में “क्योंकि… इसलिए” दोनों बोलते हैं। अंग्रेज़ी में because के साथ so नहीं लगता।
native.caption: क्या आप भी बोलते हैं: “Because it rained, so we stayed home.” 😅 सही वाक्य है: “Because it rained, we stayed home.” ध्यान रखें: because के साथ so नहीं लगता। Carlos की आवाज़ सुनकर दोहराइए! Lexkite ऐप में और अभ्यास करें।
native.comment: उत्तर: “I rested”। याद रखें: because के साथ so नहीं लगता। अब अपना एक वाक्य ज़ोर से बोलिए। मुफ़्त क्विज़ यहाँ: {link}

en.tip: Many learners use both because and so, but English needs only one of them.
en.caption: Do you say: “Because it rained, so we stayed home.” 😅 The right sentence is: “Because it rained, we stayed home.” Remember: Because already gives the reason, so skip so. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
